title: What's Your Wellness Archetype?
description: A shareable 3D artifact: user answers 3 quick questions about their stress/sleep/movement habits, and the system generates a personalized 'archetype card' — a visually striking 3D object with their result, their top product match, and a one-line hook they can post. Built for screenshots and shares. Each archetype maps to a product category, so the share drives affiliate context naturally.
mechanics: 3-question micro-quiz rendered as a cinematic 3D interaction
Result: a procedurally-styled 3D object (different geometry per archetype) with the user's archetype name floating above it
One-tap share exports a WebM clip or PNG of their archetype card
Each archetype links to the most relevant product's 3D view
